audience: Norwegian small businesses and bookkeepers who keep their accounts in Fiken

useCases.title: Find overdue customer invoices
useCases.text: List the issued invoices that are not settled and have a due date in the past. Ask the assistant to sort them by customer and amount, then open one for details.

useCases.title: Review unpaid supplier bills
useCases.text: List the purchases and supplier bills with their paid status. Ask which bills are still open, and open one purchase to see its lines and payments.

useCases.title: Check bank and account balances on a date
useCases.text: Read the bank account balances for today or a past date. Compare them with the closing balance of chosen ledger accounts.

useCases.title: Look up a customer and the sales history
useCases.text: Search the contacts by name or organization number. Then list the invoices of that customer to see what you sold and what is still unpaid.

useCases.title: Prepare an invoice draft for a customer
useCases.text: Find the customer and the products. Create an invoice draft with the lines. The draft is not booked and not sent, so you can check it in Fiken first.

useCases.title: Add a new customer and a product
useCases.text: Create a contact marked as a customer. Add a product with a price and an income account, so both are ready for the next invoice.
